mapper.select: select /* 题目详情*/ q.*, /*题目在试卷的实际分数,映射到Question的paperScore字段*/ pq.score paper_score, /*题目答案，映射到Question的answer(QuestionAnswer类型)*/ qa.id qa_id, qa.question_id qa_question_id, qa.answer qa_answer, qa.keywords qa_keywords, qa.create_time qa_create_time, qa.update_time qa_update_time, /*题目选项,映射到Question的choice中(QuestionChoice的List集合)*/ qc.id qc_id, qc.question_id qc_question_id, qc.content qc_content, qc.is_correct qc_is_correct, qc.sort qc_sort, qc.create_time qc_create_time, qc.update_time qc_update_time from questions q join paper_question pq on pq.question_id = q.id join question_answers qa on qa.question_id = q.id left join question_choices qc on qc.question_id = q.id and qc.is_deleted=0 /*left join，且不让主表收被删除选项影响条件写在了on*/ where pq.is_deleted=0 and q.is_deleted=0 and qa.is_deleted=0 and pq.paper_id = #{paperId} order by qc.sort
